# What will your GPU workload cost on each GPU cloud, and when is it cheaper to buy the card?

> Enter the GPU, the busy GPU-hours per month and how much of the time it is really busy, and see what RunPod, Lambda, Vast.ai, CoreWeave, AWS, Google Cloud and Modal charge, the 12-month spend, and how many hours a month it takes before buying the card beats renting. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
